'''2013 Worlds Day 1 Ross Littauer LS Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ross Littauer]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Diplomatic Mission To Alderaan / New Allies|V3-L-diplomaticmissiontoalderaan.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
